options.text: The finished difference is the label negative tokens.
Remove $6$ positive tokens from the $4$ he has.
Add $2$ zero pairs, then remove $6$ positive tokens; $2$ negative tokens remain.
The finished difference is what creates the need for zero pairs.

stem:
Sagar models integers with tokens. He has $4$ positive tokens and must subtract $6$ positive tokens.

Which move lets him complete the subtraction?

teacher.key_rationale: He needs 6 positive tokens to remove but has only 4, so he adds 2 zero pairs first. After removing 6 positive tokens, 2 negative tokens remain (−2). Naming the label, removing without zero pairs, or reversing the role of zero pairs all miss that move.
